related.title: Faster R-CNN：錨框候選與共享特徵
related.titleEn: Faster R-CNN: anchor proposals and shared features
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付金字塔shape表、層指派例及記憶體取捨。；總位置5440及21824正確，所有側向相加座標契約一致。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver pyramid shapes, assignment examples and memory tradeoffs.; Counts5440 and21824 match and lateral additions share consistent coordinate contracts.
related.difference: 為單個特徵中心列9組尺度比例，再標影像座標、邊界裁切及物件性分數。；3600及2400可核對，IoU基本案例正確且窄框召回差異有證據。
related.differenceEn: Enumerate nine scale-ratio pairs at one feature center and annotate image coordinates, clipping and objectness.; Counts and basic IoUs match, with evidence for narrow-box recall differences.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 金字塔每層長寬減半，總位置數是各層面積和；側向相加需對齊通道與座標。；教學四層64、32、16、8方形網格；擴充一層128。；N=64²+32²+16²+8²=5440；加128層為21824。
每位置a個錨框，候選數HWa；這是篩選前數量，不等於最終偵測數。；教學H=W=20，3尺度×3比例=9錨框；改3尺度×2比例。；N=20×20×9=3600；6錨框時2400。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Each pyramid level halves both dimensions; total positions sum areas, and lateral addition requires aligned channels and coordinates.; Teaching square grids64,32,16,8; add a128 level.; N=64²+32²+16²+8²=5440; adding128 gives21824.
With a anchors per position, proposals number HWa before filtering, not final detections.; Teaching20×20 map with3 scales×3 ratios=9 anchors; compare3×2.; N=20×20×9=3600; six anchors give2400.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: T5：跨度去噪與哨兵介面
related.titleEn: T5: span corruption and sentinel contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付金字塔shape表、層指派例及記憶體取捨。；總位置5440及21824正確，所有側向相加座標契約一致。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver pyramid shapes, assignment examples and memory tradeoffs.; Counts5440 and21824 match and lateral additions share consistent coordinate contracts.
related.difference: 用字母序列標四段連續刪除區，編碼器放不同哨兵，解碼器依序還原各段。；84與85長度吻合，還原序列完全相同，EOS計數單獨列出。
related.differenceEn: Mark four contiguous spans in a letter sequence; insert distinct encoder sentinels and reconstruct spans in decoder order.; Lengths84 and85 match, reconstruction is exact and EOS accounting is separate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 金字塔每層長寬減半，總位置數是各層面積和；側向相加需對齊通道與座標。；教學四層64、32、16、8方形網格；擴充一層128。；N=64²+32²+16²+8²=5440；加128層為21824。
以每跨度一哨兵替換時，編碼器長度N−M+S；此計數不含額外EOS。；教學原100token，移除20token分4跨度；改為5跨度但移除量不變。；L=100−20+4=84；5跨度時85。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Each pyramid level halves both dimensions; total positions sum areas, and lateral addition requires aligned channels and coordinates.; Teaching square grids64,32,16,8; add a128 level.; N=64²+32²+16²+8²=5440; adding128 gives21824.

Replacing each corrupted span with one sentinel gives encoder length N−M+S, excluding extra EOS.; Teaching100 tokens with20 removed in four spans; change to five spans at fixed removed count.; L=100−20+4=84; five spans give85.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
